policy_cards.title: Rate limit count and window must be explicit
policy_cards.requirement: Rate limits must define the exact maximum count and rolling time window.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Ambiguous limits cause off-by-one or unbounded request behavior.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: A user may make at most 5 requests in any rolling 60 second window.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec define both the exact request count and time window?
policy_cards.requirement_test: Boundary behavior at exactly 5 requests must be correct
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Ambiguous limits cause off-by-one or unbounded request behavior.
audit_questions: Does the spec define both the exact request count and time window?
policy_cards.example_failure: Ambiguous limits cause off-by-one or unbounded request behavior.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: A user may make at most 5 requests in any rolling 60 second window.

policy_cards.title: Rate limits must be per user
policy_cards.requirement: Different users must have independent rate limits.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: A global limiter can block unrelated users or let one user consume another user's quota.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Rate limit state must be tracked independently per user.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec say the limit is per user, not global?
policy_cards.requirement_test: The limit is per user, not global
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: A global limiter can block unrelated users or let one user consume another user's quota.
audit_questions: Does the spec say the limit is per user, not global?
policy_cards.example_failure: A global limiter can block unrelated users or let one user consume another user's quota.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Rate limit state must be tracked independently per user.

policy_cards.title: The first request over the limit must be blocked
policy_cards.requirement: The 6th request inside a 60 second window must be blocked.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: The limiter can appear implemented while allowing the first abusive request over the limit.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: The 6th request inside the same 60 second window must be blocked.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec explicitly block the 6th request?
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: The limiter can appear implemented while allowing the first abusive request over the limit.
audit_questions: Does the spec explicitly block the 6th request?
policy_cards.example_failure: The limiter can appear implemented while allowing the first abusive request over the limit.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: The 6th request inside the same 60 second window must be blocked.

policy_cards.title: Tenant exports must not cross tenant boundary
policy_cards.requirement: Export must not include records from other tenants.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Cross-tenant exports leak data across customer boundaries.
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Records from another tenant can be exported if they match non-tenant filters.
audit_questions: Does the spec require tenant_id scoping for every exported record?
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Exports must include only records whose tenant_id matches the requesting actor tenant_id, regardless of other filters.
policy_cards.example_failure: Filtering by status returns another tenant record with the same status.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Exported records must all have tenant_id equal to actor.tenant_id.
policy_cards.requirement_test: Export must not include records from other tenants

policy_cards.title: Filters must not override tenant isolation
policy_cards.requirement: Filters must not override tenant isolation.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: A user-provided tenant filter can bypass isolation.
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: An attacker can request another tenant_id in filters.
audit_questions: Does the spec say user filters cannot override actor tenant scope?
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: User-provided filters must not override tenant scope; actor.tenant_id is authoritative.
policy_cards.example_failure: filters.tenant_id=t2 returns t2 records for a t1 actor.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Tenant scope is derived only from the authenticated actor.
policy_cards.requirement_test: Filters must not override tenant isolation
